text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 160 mm length of 50 x 50 x 5 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 5.5 mm holes 25 mm up from the corner, 25 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each end. Drill the box's inner mounting plate through them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M5 screws through the inner plate, nuts behind it. The flat leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: points out toward the lid, 26 mm above the box floor so the gland

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nuts below it stay clear. The shelf sits at the left of the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 27 x 4 mm slots in the inner plate, above and below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: battery, 37 mm left of centre, for the battery strap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The battery (151 x 65 x 98 mm, 2.2 kg) stands on the flat leg, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back against the upright leg; the strap goes over and under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the battery strapped, it does not move when the box is tipped.
